name: University of Saint Francis
oos_note: private single rate = in-state; University of Saint Francis (Fort Wayne, IN) is a private Catholic university charging one tuition rate to all students. 2025-26 tuition & fees (tuition $35,210 + semester fee $540 + technology fee $710 = $36,460 commuter total, excludes room/board) from sf.edu tuition-and-fees page.
